status: Proposed next generic geometry format; no producer command or app admission
longIndex: Sorted canonical physical arc u24 keys with u16 upward-rounded full source-curve length in eight-meter units, plus one extra unit. Sentinel 65535 uses sparse u24 arc/u32 unit overflow tables. No graph cost/topology change.
candidateCoverageProof: Every simplified segment joins retained source points; by the triangle inequality its total length is no greater than the original source curve L. Every point on that curve lies within L/2 along the curve of at least one endpoint. If its distance to an origin is d, at least one endpoint is within d+L/2. Short curves use the anchor-cell index with a 500 m endpoint allowance; long curves use the conservative rounded length. This is a nearest-modeled-curve candidate bound, not shore/access/source-transfer or true-road accuracy proof.
tradeoff: Scanning compact long-arc keys/lengths needs endpoint-distance checks at query time. Measure real source-snap runtime before admission. It avoids retaining redundant four-coordinate bounding boxes.
